instructions.stage: Recrear las expresiones tomando el rostro del avatar original como referencia
instructions.prompt:
Image 1 is the ORIGINAL AVATAR and the primary EDIT SOURCE. Its face and nose are correct. Image 2 is a supporting reference for the animation layout and poses only; its nose is wrong and must NOT be copied.

Create a transparent sprite sheet of the ORIGINAL AVATAR FROM IMAGE 1, exactly 4 columns x 2 rows, 1774x887 canvas. Use image 1's exact face with its original tiny asymmetrical peach/coral pixel NOSE in every frame. Keep that NOSE UNCHANGED from image 1. It is a light block at upper-left plus a coral stepped upward-turning mark on lower-right, not two separate nostril dots. The original face from image1 is the base for all eight portraits, especially preserve its nose geometry when changing eyes or mouth. Do not use the face or nose from image2.

Preserve image1's shoulder-length hair, corrected muted brown base #795042 highlights #c68864, near-black jacket, white top, tiny labret, earrings and Jerry held on viewer-right. Make the pixel art as clear and blocky as image2, with stepped square edges and hard shade clusters.
For layout, pose and animations copy image2: top row four idle frames with eyes open/open/closed/open and Jerry neutral/head-ear tilt/blink/neutral; bottom row four happy frames with Vanessa joyful open mouth and happy closed eyes, Jerry winking/raised paw/head lean/nuzzle and returning upright, and the yellow three-ray gleam pulsing. Fixed Vanessa torso and head size, generous cell margins, fixed bust baseline, complete silhouettes and no frame overlap.
Highest priority: all eight Vanessa faces keep the ORIGINAL NOSE of image1. Same natural tiny nose and its exact shape, proportionate to her face. Change only the expressions around the existing nose, not the nose itself.
No words, numbers, frames, grid or opaque background. True alpha transparency.

Change ONLY the transparent spacing between the eight frames. There is not enough horizontal gap between Jerry's tilted ear in top-row frame2 and the next Vanessa portrait.
Uniformly reduce the artwork in EACH of the eight cells by 10 percent about its bust anchor, and recenter each pair in its own cell, to leave at least20pixels of fully transparent gutter between every neighboring portrait. Every complete Vanessa/Jerry silhouette, including Jerry's tilted ears and yellow rays, must fit within its own square cell and never overlap or touch its neighbors.
Keep the canvas exactly1774x887, four equal columns and two rows, eight frames in the same order. Fixed consistent Vanessa size and bust baseline across frames.
Do NOT redraw or change the noses: preserve the exact new tiny asymmetric peach/coral nose from this source in ALL eight faces, with its light upper-left patch and short coral stepped lower-right tip. Do not turn it into two nostril dots or a big upright L. Preserve faces, all expressions, hair length, muted brown/copper hair colors, black jacket, white top, piercing, earrings, Jerry's existing head/ear/paw poses, and yellow three-ray gleam. Keep the same crisp pixel-art style. Only shrink/reposition whole frame artwork uniformly to fix gutters. Full real alpha transparency. No background, grid, frame borders, labels or extraobjects.

Use case: precise-object-edit.
Image 1 is the EDIT TARGET: the eight-frame transparent Vanessa/Jerry pixel-art avatar sheet. Image 2 is the user's precise NOSE REFERENCE, the original avatar.

Replace ONLY Vanessa's nose in all eight frames with the nose design of image 2, proportionally scaled to her face. Remove the current oversized vertical L-shaped nose. The reference nose is a TINY, LOW, SUBTLE peach/coral pixel cluster: a light peach square on the upper left and one small muted coral shadow on the lower right. It has NO upright vertical bridge, NO long stem, NO sharp projecting hook, NO black outline and NO red-orange bulb. Keep it about 8-10 output pixels wide and 5-7 pixels tall in each frame, no bigger. It should read as the same delicate hint of a nose from image 2 rather than a separate drawn feature. Keep its position consistent relative to her eyes and mouth.

Keep EVERYTHING else exactly as image 1: clearly chunky pixel art, shoulder-length hair and current muted brown/copper colors, eyes, mouth and all expressions, black jackets, white tops, earrings and labret piercing, Jerry's head/ear/paw/wink poses, yellow gleam, all eight poses and frame order, 4 columns by 2 rows, 1774x887 canvas, character size, alignment and transparency. Only replace the nose; no other face redesign, text or background.

EDIT IMAGE 1 ONLY: add Vanessa's VERY TINY nose from image 2 to the eight faces.
Image 1 is the version BEFORE the large ugly nose was drawn. Keep it as the exact base.
Image 2 is the original avatar. Look closely at the nose: it is only two tiny peach/coral pixel marks diagonally adjacent, a short wide tip. COPY THAT SHAPE, scaled down to these faces.
In every face add only a tiny flat peach pixel cluster centered between eyes and mouth: total width about 6 pixels, total height about 3 pixels on this 1774x887 sheet. A slightly lighter peach mark on upper-left and a small soft coral mark on lower-right. No vertical nose bridge and no L-shaped upright stroke. Do not add a big red triangular nose or strong shadows. It should be barely noticeable but present, like the original avatar. The user disliked the last large nose and wants the original delicate pixel nose.
Keep all other pixels and details unchanged: 8 frames, chunky pixel art, current brown hair colors and hairstyle, black jacket, earrings and labret, eyes, mouth, Jerry's movement, yellow rays, canvas and transparent background. No text or other edits.
